gloss: to subsidize; to grant aid; to provide financial assistance

definitions.gloss: to subsidize; to grant aid; to provide financial assistance
definitions.explanation: To provide financial support, typically from a government body, foundation, or organization, to fund research, projects, or activities deemed beneficial to society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{助成|じょせい}する。
⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{助成|じょせい}する⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a system where the government provides financial assistance to child-rearing households.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{財団|ざいだん}→財団：11331_zaidan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧、⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{助成|じょせい}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}→数百万円：28274_suuhyakumanen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拠出|きょしゅつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This foundation contributes millions of yen every year to subsidize cultural activities.

notes:
Composed of {助|じょ} (help) + {成|せい} (achieve/accomplish), referring to financial support that helps something succeed. Primarily used in official and institutional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{助成金|じょせいきん}→助成金：11343_joseikin⟧: subsidy; grant; financial aid
- ⟦{助成|じょせい}→助成：21479_josei⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: subsidy system/program
- ⟦{助成|じょせい}→助成：21479_josei⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: subsidized project
- ⟦{助成|じょせい}→助成：21479_josei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a subsidy
- ⟦{助成|じょせい}→助成：21479_josei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for a grant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{補助|ほじょ}→補助：14105_hojo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assist/supplement — broader, includes non-financial help
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}する→援助する：26855_enjosuru⟧: to aid/assist — more general, can include humanitarian aid
- ⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧: to support — the most general term for support
